question: P @ Q means P is Father of Q, P & Q means P is Daughter of Q, P # Q means P is Sister of Q. In the expression K @ L # M & N, how is K related to N?
solution:
Family Chart:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/47a89a5bb9daa01f32d67cf5151f1acc95989e845ae3c3eb86353e0d1da9cbdc.png] 

Decoding the Symbols:

 
 

 Symbol
 @
 &
 #
 
 

 Meaning
 Father
 Daughter
 Sister
 
 

 

Given: K @ L # M & N

It means:

P @ Q means P is Father of Q,

P & Q means P is Daughter of Q,

P # Q means P is Sister of Q. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d6224bf693e0a20b1de52c2cf3529c0f01106f5e69980033be2e031986130e18.png] 

So, K is the **'Husband'** of N.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
